purpose: Visual-only companion catalog for combat entities, abilities, and upgrade tracks. It intentionally excludes costs, damage, HP, cooldowns, reward amounts, and unlock economy values.

separationRules.runtimeArtRule: World art, UI icons, portraits, VFX, and audio cues are replaceable without changing balance config IDs.
